title: Induction Machine Field-Oriented Control
text: Per-unit discrete-time induction machine FOC, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {Rated voltage, rms line-to-line (V)} sets the voltage, {Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency, {Rotor resistance, referred to the stator side (pu)} sets the resistance, {Rotor leakage inductance, referred to the stator side (pu)} sets the inductance, {Magnetizing inductance (pu)} sets the inductance, {Time constant for dq currents filters (s)} sets the time constant 1e-4, {Inverter dc-link voltage threshold (V)} sets the voltage, {Fundamental sample time (s)} sets the time 5e-6, {Control sample time (s)} sets the time 5e-5, {Magnetizing current controller proportional gain} sets the gain, {Magnetizing current controller integral gain} sets the gain, {Magnetizing current controller integral anti-windup gain} sets the gain, {Speed controller proportional gain} sets the gain, {Speed controller integral gain} sets the gain, {Speed controller integral anti-windup gain} sets the gain, {Maximum d-axis current [pu]} sets the current, {Maximum q-axis current [pu]} sets the current, {Phase-a axis alignment} sets the dq0 reference frame, {D-axis current proportional gain} sets the d -axis proportional gain, {D-axis current integral gain} sets the d -axis integral gain, {D-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the d -axis anti-windup gain, {Q-axis current proportional gain} sets the q -axis proportional gain, {Q-axis current integral gain} sets the q -axis integral gain, {Q-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the q -axis anti-windup gain, {Axis prioritization}, {PWM method} sets the pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector and {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate. Values come from the instance.
